reviewKind: Document and evidence cross-check for a schematic visual study
findings: Official institutional sources corroborate authorship, date, temple type, 46 + 12 exterior Doric columns and separated east/west chambers.
Tufts catalog provides useful dimensional aggregates, but not a georeferenced or per-member surveyed model.
Exterior approximate scaling can be constrained, while details of column refinements, ceilings, polychromy and original sculpture remain unresolved.
The intended digital exhibit must not be described as accurate restoration or conservation-grade reconstruction.
openItems: Complete structural and sculpture reconstruction evidence
